marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

output.meta_commit_message: docs(task-dependencies): SO33 conflict copies never feed successor offers

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Implemented the approved plan. Successor and recovery pools now skip `_conflicts/` sync copies.

**What changed**
- `bob-plugins`, [`task-status-cycler`](https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-plugins) ([`9b4bc2ca`](https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-plugins/commit/9b4bc2ca)): the existing `isExcludedSuccessorVaultPath` predicate now gates every vault-wide task source — Tasks-cache read, open-buffer pool build, cold-document scan, cold recovery file list, project-blocking open-id scan, and the three `[id::]` scans (ambiguity, propagation, collisions) — plus the post-picker fresh re-plan, where an open excluded buffer was re-adding rows. `.bob` added to the excluded set; manifest bumped to 1.58.0 with rebuilt `main.js` and regenerated docs inventory.
- `bob-cli` ([`b7945e75`](https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli/commit/b7945e75)): `docs/task-dependencies.md` §12.7 row 3 notes the exclusion, and §12.12 gains vector **SO33**. One sentence added to the cycler doc.
- Synced the rebuilt cycler to the vault; verified the deployed `main.js` carries the fix.

**Verification (observed)**
- 8 new SO33 tests: 7 fail on the pre-fix build and pass after; the 8th pins the predicate contract.
- 299/299 pass across all 13 task-status-cycler suites; `build:check`, docs inventory check, and manifest validation green.

**Blockers to know about**
- Full `npm test` and both `docs-check` gates cannot run here: the machine disk is 100% full (45G of shared caches; not mine to delete) and `just docs-check` also fails on a pre-existing `reference/plugins` mount conflict. `bob plugins sync` from another checkout's uncommitted block-id-prompt build is still refused — left for its owner per the no-`-F` rule.
